strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: a tu lio keybox kha Google's revocation list (CRL) he a zoh i a hmanmi keybox a hmuh hlan tiang source tampi a hneksak, amah tein backup a tuah i Google riantuannak hna kha a thawk tthan. Tap tik paoh ah a kal i internet a herh (minute 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Network in keybox: official repository (GitHub) in keybox pakhat a download i /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. ah a chiah Internet a herh i minutes 1-3 a rau. Smart fetch a tlamtlin lo tikah asiloah keybox kha kut in thlen a si tikah hman a si.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP thlopnak: a ummi Remote Key Provisioning modules pawl kha a zoh, TEE attestation certificate version kha a zoh, cun KmInstallKeybox thilri dirhmun kha a langhter. Zeihmanh a thlen lo — thilri dirhmun zoh sawhsawh.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file umtuning le aa pehtlaimi system thilri hna in Widevine level hmelchunhnak (L1/L3) a langhter. Zeihmanh a remh lo.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP remhnak: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual a kalpi. Automatic pass a tlamtlin lo tikah fehternak kong he pehtlai in buainak a remh. A tlik tik paoh ah hlawhtlinnak/hlawhtlin lonak line fiang tein a langhter.
strings.mdRkpFull: • RKP tling tein remh: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh tling tein a kalpi. A harmi thil pawl a tawlrel i caan sau deuh a rau. A donghnak ah a fiangmi phichuak a lang.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: Play Store le Google riantuannak (GMS+GSF) data kha a hloh i thilri kha amah tein a thawk tthan. A lung a hakmi tehte khannak ca lawng ah — na hmanthlak le na file pawl kha a tawng bal hna lo.
strings.mdCertify: • Play fehternak: thilri i RKP fehternak dirhmun kha a zoh i a herh ahcun fehternak thilri kha a remh ṭhan. Hmantu data a tawngh lo.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER remhnak: thilri fehternak he aa pehtlaimi Google riantuannak phunglam (SOTER) konglam hna kha a remh. Play Integrity si loin SOTER aa bochanmi thilri cheukhat caah hman a si.
strings.mdPifApply: • PIF hman: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh thazaang a kalpi. Thimmi kutdonghrolh (local/advanced) kha a hman i pif.prop/pif.json file pawl kha a tharchuah. A fiangmi phichuak cu log ah a lang.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: chiahmi engine dirhmun, kutdong hmelchunhnak file (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), le cazin pawl a langhter. Check lawng — zeihmanh a remh lo.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary tharchuah: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m a kalpi. A herhmi RKP cazin (February 2026) he aa tlak khawhnak hnga Canary Engine chuahmi thar bik kha a lak.
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine thlopnak: TrickyStoreOSS dirhmun (pid, logs), keybox file (a cawlcangmi le hmantu), a taktak le a hmaan lomi thilri kutdonghrolh, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP tawhfung hna kha a zoh. Zawtnak thlopnak langhternak lawng.
strings.btnKbSlotsPreferSecondary: 🔁 A changtu kha ka duh deuh
strings.btnKbSlotsPromote: ⬆️ A pahnihnak → a hrampi kha thanchoter
strings.hintKbSlots: Module nih keybox hmun pahnih a tawlrel: a hrampi (a thiangmi, hloh bal lomi) le a pahnihnak (a hnulei). Hi tab nih hin zei slot dah a cawlcang, duhnak a thlen, asiloah a fiangmi halnak ah a pahnihnak kha a hrampi ah a thanchoter — backup le log tling he a langhter.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • A hmaanmi thlennak: TEE key luhternak, keystore2 chung i library luhternak, hnonnak dirhmun (CRL), kilvennak-cazin huapnak le RKP dirhmun kha a zoh. Rel khawhmi lawng — zeihmanh a thlen lo.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 A himmi hman tthan:

• Install tuahmi app kip in kilvennak cazin cu ser tthan a si.
• Custom-ROM aa tlaknak tthen cu hman tthan a si.
• A cawlcangmi keybox cu hman tthan a si.

00# riantuannak hna cu thawk tthan.

Zeihmanh hloh a si lo i a hrampi keybox cu tawngh bal a si lo.

Pehzulh?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: a hrampi le a pahnihnak slots dirhmun a langhter i an karlak ah duhnak a thlen. A hrampi (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) cu a kilven zungzal i a hloh bal lo. A pahnihnak kha a hrampi ah tthanchoternak nih fiang tein fehternak a herh.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promote the secondary slot to primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml becomes the primary slot content.
• The current primary is saved as a backup before replacement.
• Nothing is deleted — the operation is reversible.

Continue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 A pahnihnak hmunhma kha thianh:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml cu hloh a si lai.
• A hrampi hmunhma cu tawngh a si lo.

Pehzulh?

strings.confirmGmsReset:
Restart Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — restart only.
• Nothing is wiped and you will NOT be signed out.
• The device reboots automatically.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• A chuakmi keybox zei ah a rel lomi thilri hna caah.
• Key pawl an dam ko zongah a ttha.
• Data pakhat hmanh hloh a si lo.

Pehzulh?
strings.confirmCertify:
Force Play Store certification:

• Store cache lawng a thianh — na account cu a tongh lo.
• Reboot tuah, cun Store kha on.

Pehzulh?
strings.confirmSoter:
